MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES FOR TUESDAY, MAY-02-2006: Russell H. Townsend, Esq. appears for plaintiff Patricia Hwee Lim, who is also present this date; Gen Fujioka, Esq., Asian Law Caucus appears for Defendant Mr. Hant Lim, who is also present this day; also present is Ms. Winnie Yu, Mandarin Language Interpreter, to assist Defendant Mr. Hant Lim during the settlement conference this day.
Settlement Conference held; the case settles; D-206 trial date removed;terms of the settlement placed on the record and include the following:

Plaintiff Counsel Russell H. Townsend is to prepare a written stipulation based on this matter set forth today: Judgment and a Writ of Possession will issue in the event Defendant Mr. Hant Lim has not vacated the premises located at 1355 Bayshore Boulevard, San Francisco, CA by FEB-28-2007. If Defendant H. Lim vacates the premise by FEB-28-2007, the matter will be dismissed with no judgment against him; terms contained herein shall survive dismissal; during the continued occupancy by Defendant H. Lim, he is not to disturb tenants in the upstairs unit and is to ensure no damage or destruction occurs in the unit he occupies; Defendant Mr. Hant Lim is to keep the place neat and clean and shall not allow any other person to reside there; he is to allow Plaintiff P. H. Lim continued access to the garage and bedroom where she stores her deceased husband's belongings, as he has done in the past; during the ten-month period, Defendant is to pay a rent as follows: $300.00 per month for the first four months and the sum of $600.00 per month during the last six months. In the event Defendant H. Lim fails to vacate premise by FEB-28-2007, both parties waive any and all rights to Hant Lim's residency & waive rights under Civil Code Section 1542; each party to bear its own costs, including costs for preparation of stipulation executed by parties.
JUDGE PRO TEM REGGIE GRINER; REPORTER: BELDEN YEE, CSR #2647; CLERK MARJORIE MANZELLA (218/206)
